name: igly-canvas
description: Draw flowcharts, mind maps, roadmaps, wireframes, storyboards, moodboards and template-based designs on an editable Igly canvas, right in the chat.

interface.shortDescription: Draw diagrams, boards and layouts on an editable canvas.
interface.longDescription: Ask for a flowchart, mind map, roadmap, kanban or retro board, wireframe, storyboard, moodboard or a poster from one of thousands of templates. The board appears in the chat, you can move and edit everything by hand, export a PNG, and open it in the full Igly editor.
defaultPrompt: Draw a flowchart of our customer onboarding
Make a mind map for a podcast launch
Turn this plan into a Q1 to Q4 roadmap
Sketch a wireframe for a pricing page
